source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {v: (r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v in (1, 2)}
    (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = points[1], points[2]
    dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
    sr = (dr > 0) - (dr < 0)
    sc = (dc > 0) - (dc < 0)
    diagonal = min(abs(dr), abs(dc))
    # The path uses all but one possible diagonal step from the 1 end,
    # an axial middle section, then a final diagonal step into 2.
    prefix = max(0, diagonal - 1)
    r, c = r1, c1
    def paint(rr, cc):
        if grid[rr][cc] == 0:
            out[rr][cc] = 3
    for _ in range(prefix):
        r += sr
        c += sc
        paint(r, c)
    final_diagonal = 1 if dr and dc else 0
    row_steps = abs(dr) - prefix - final_diagonal
    col_steps = abs(dc) - prefix - final_diagonal
    for _ in range(row_steps):
        r += sr
        paint(r, c)
    for _ in range(col_steps):
        c += sc
        paint(r, c)
    if final_diagonal:
        r += sr
        c += sc
        paint(r, c)
    return out
'''
